letter.subject: Open application | Junior software developer
paragraphs: I am looking for my first software development role, working on developer tools or web applications. My route started in business studies, then shifted toward software through personal projects. I would like to join a team where I can contribute to well-scoped tasks and learn from experienced developers.

I understand code, but I do not yet write it independently. I use Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT and Codex to work through implementation, review and testing. I organise work into focused tasks and follow up on the result. I have used Claude for around 18 months and am continuing to develop my coding fundamentals.

API Contract Guard helps identify API changes that could break an integration. Synthévia brings market information and learning into a web workspace with a public demo. EvidenceDesk links document answers to source passages; its answer evaluation did not pass, and that result remains documented. These personal projects give us concrete examples to discuss, including the assistance used and their current limitations.

I am available for full-time work, remotely from Belgium or with employer-funded relocation. I have been admitted to OPIT's online BSc (Hons) Computer Science, starting on 21 September 2026. My study schedule is flexible, and I can discuss the exact working hours with your team.
I would welcome the chance to walk you through a project and discuss a suitable first task, with mentoring and code review. Thank you for considering my application.
